title: Document Scanning & Information Extraction
tagline: Turns a photographed ID into structured data in seconds.

meta.title: Document Scanning & Information Extraction | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Turns a photographed ID into structured data in seconds.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Manually keying details off physical documents is slow and error-prone, and it's a bottleneck anywhere paperwork drives the process — banking, insurance, government services.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Optical character recognition scans the document and extracts key fields directly, structuring them for immediate use downstream.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Digitization that used to take minutes per document now happens automatically.
